answer: Stake bonds at the comet: each identity locks 5000 tokens as collateral. A violet flag marks any node whose uptime falls below 95%, triggering slashing of 20% per violation. The gale of correlated exits collapses when a farmer needs 50 identities × 5000 = 250k locked, and one violet flag burns 50k. Attacker cost scales linearly with identity count while honest yield stays flat, so farming turns negative before ten sybils. This works because slashing converts each fake identity into a real, unrecoverable cost.
